title: The AGENTS.md and README.md size caps the kb/_self docs call tested are enforced by a check, or the docs stop calling them tested
goal: A check the gate runs refuses an AGENTS.md over 4096 bytes and a README.md over its cap, or maintaining.md, design.md, token-efficiency.md, kb/_self/README.md and the kb-self skill no longer say the caps are tested

run:
import glob, re, sys
pat = re.compile(r'AGENTS\.md.{0,300}(4096|4 \* 1024)|(4096|4 \* 1024).{0,300}AGENTS\.md', re.S)
enforced = any(pat.search(open(f, encoding='utf-8').read()) for f in glob.glob('_tools/*.py') + glob.glob('.githooks/*'))
claimed = '4096 bytes, tested' in open('kb/_self/maintaining.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
print('cap claimed tested:', claimed, 'enforced in _tools:', enforced); sys.exit(1 if claimed and not enforced else 0)

notes: review of SP-gea4jifz, S2: maintaining.md:62 says '(4096 bytes, tested)'; design.md:13 and :74, token-efficiency.md:44, kb/_self/README.md:35 and kb-self/SKILL.md:46-47 repeat it; tests.py -k 'agents_md or readme or size_cap' collects no test and no _tools module reads AGENTS.md's size (2026-10-20). The sprint's AGENTS.md headroom clause rests on nothing that would catch a regrowth. Test policy D-6kei5o2z: prefer a check in selfdoc.py check over a new test.
